_comment: Each command falls back to an empty allow-decision when the script is missing. preToolUse hooks fail CLOSED on error, so a deleted script otherwise denies EVERY tool call in any session that already loaded this config - measured 2026-08-02, recoverable only by restarting the CLI.

preToolUse.bash: if [ -f scripts/hooks/credential_gate.py ]; then python scripts/hooks/credential_gate.py; else echo '{}'; fi

permissionRequest.bash: if [ -f scripts/hooks/credential_gate.py ]; then python scripts/hooks/credential_gate.py; else echo '{}'; fi
